Test Case Name: Verify Processing Status Tile Displays All Status Types
Description: Verify the Processing Status tile is visible and displays saved/for approval/approved statuses
Pre-conditions: User logged in; Records exist in saved - for approval - and approved states
Step Description: Navigate to the application dashboard
Expected Result: Dashboard loads with Processing Status (Bearbeitungsstatus) tile visible

Step Description: Observe the Processing Status tile
Expected Result: Tile shows indicators for all three status types

Step Description: Verify saved status represented with save icon
Expected Result: Save icon visible on tile

Step Description: Verify for approval status represented with single orange tick
Expected Result: Orange tick visible on tile

Step Description: Verify approved status represented with green double tick
Expected Result: Green double tick visible on tile

Test Case Name: Verify Pop-up Opens and Displays Actions with Correct Icons
Description: Verify activating tile opens pop-up showing all action types with appropriate status icons
Pre-conditions: User logged in; Records exist in all three states; Dashboard displayed
Step Description: Click on the Processing Status tile
Expected Result: Pop-up window opens displaying actions being processed

Step Description: Verify saved actions displayed with save icon and area information
Expected Result: Saved actions listed with save icon and selectable area

Step Description: Verify for approval actions displayed with single orange tick icon
Expected Result: For approval actions listed with orange tick

Step Description: Verify approved actions displayed with green double tick icon
Expected Result: Approved actions listed with green double tick

Test Case Name: Verify Navigation to Original Mask and Continue Release Process
Description: Verify selecting area in pop-up navigates to Bearbeiten page where user can continue release process
Pre-conditions: Writer or Admin user logged in; Saved action exists; Pop-up displayed
Step Description: Select a saved action/area in the pop-up
Expected Result: Navigation to Bearbeiten (Edit) page initiates

Step Description: Verify record displayed with updated data in left column and production data in right column
Expected Result: Bearbeiten page shows correct layout with updated fields highlighted in green

Step Description: Verify Send for Approval button is enabled
Expected Result: Send for Approval button available

Step Description: Click Send for Approval
Expected Result: Record sent for approval; status changes to orange tick; record becomes non-editable

Step Description: Navigate back to Processing Status pop-up and select a for approval action (sent by another user)
Expected Result: Navigate to record in for approval state

Step Description: Verify Approve and Reject buttons are enabled
Expected Result: Both action buttons available

Step Description: Click Approve to complete release process
Expected Result: Record approved; green double tick displayed; release user and timestamp updated

Test Case Name: Verify Role-Based Access - Viewer User View-Only Mode
Description: Verify Viewer user can access tile and pop-up but navigates to view-only mode
Pre-conditions: Viewer user logged in with view-only access
Step Description: Navigate to dashboard and verify Processing Status tile is visible
Expected Result: Tile visible for Viewer user

Step Description: Activate Processing Status tile
Expected Result: Pop-up opens showing all action statuses

Step Description: Select an action to navigate to Bearbeiten page
Expected Result: Navigation occurs; page opens in view-only mode

Step Description: Verify all fields are disabled and only Schließen (Close) button enabled
Expected Result: All fields disabled; only Close button enabled; no edit capability

Test Case Name: Verify Sender Cannot Approve Own Record
Description: Verify user who sent record for approval cannot approve their own submission
Pre-conditions: Writer user logged in; User has sent own record for approval
Step Description: Navigate to dashboard and activate Processing Status tile
Expected Result: Pop-up opens

Step Description: Select own record that is in for approval state
Expected Result: Navigation to Bearbeiten page occurs

Step Description: Verify Approve and Reject buttons are disabled for sender
Expected Result: Only Close button enabled for sender

Step Description: Verify message Record not editable is displayed
Expected Result: Non-editable message shown confirming sender restriction

Description: Verify pop-up display when no records exist in any processing state
Pre-conditions: User logged in; No records in saved/for approval/approved states
Step Description: Ensure no records are in any processing state
Expected Result: System has no pending actions

Step Description: Navigate to dashboard and activate Processing Status tile
Expected Result: Pop-up opens

Step Description: Verify pop-up content when no actions exist
Expected Result: Insufficient information to determine exact empty state message - pop-up behavior with no data not specified
